scope: No production/test/SDK changes, target build, hardware access, stress execution or active screen11 reads. Only this new JSON written.
decision: A single application preferredMtu=247u to517u change is a viable bounded-buffer experiment using the current protocol, conditional on real peer MTU negotiation. It is not a demonstrated throughput fix.

unique_setting.only_call: sensorarrayBleInit(&bleConfig) at776 is the only production call site found.
unique_setting.minimal_candidate: Change only the explicit caller literal to517u. Retain fallback247u for an unspecified config, all MTU snapshots, queue/packet capacities, priority, budgets and planner algorithm.
unique_setting.local_set_error: API enqueue/init error is logged by sensorarrayBleLogBoot("mtu",err); Init currently continues. ESP_OK means asynchronous local configuration request queued, not negotiation completed.
unique_setting.default_link: Stats MTU starts23 at init and resets23 on CONNECT/DISCONNECT; only ESP_GATTS_MTU_EVT assigns negotiated param->mtu.mtu.
unique_setting.configured_vs_actual: BLEBOOT prints preferred configured MTU, so BLEBOOT mtu517 cannot prove negotiated517. BLELINK?/BL50 mtu reflects event-driven connection state.

primary_sdk_semantics.legal_range: esp_gatt_common_api.h defines23 default and517 maximum; esp_ble_gatt_set_local_mtu validates inclusive range then posts BTC_GATT_ACT_SET_LOCAL_MTU.
primary_sdk_semantics.peer_min: gatt_sr.c:gatts_process_mtu_req lines1144-1186 selects23 if peer<23, otherwise min(peer requested MTU,gatt_default.local_mtu), then sends response and application MTU callback.
primary_sdk_semantics.direction: The peripheral raises its local receive/ATT limit; it cannot force a central to request517 or initiate a new exchange. Same host may remain247 or another value. No manual OS/administrator changes are part of this proposal.
primary_sdk_semantics.reset: New firmware/reconnect is required to observe a fresh negotiation; existing connection must not inherit another peer's old MTU.

buffer_and_wire.maximum_value: Both SendPayload and SendFragment enforce min(actualMTU-3,512). MTU517 gives514 ATT bytes but existing app limit512; no buffer expansion required.
buffer_and_wire.fixed_storage: GATT CTRL_RX/CTRL_TX/DATA/LOG attribute max512; persistent txPacketScratch512; source slot max2304 and CTRL max512 stay unchanged.
buffer_and_wire.fragmentation: Same G channel/mid/index/count/chunk/total/CRC fields, same balanced planner and actual snprintf; fragments are sized from a per-message connection snapshot.
buffer_and_wire.raw_transition: Messages length<=512 may become raw ATT values at negotiated517, while prior247 used G envelopes. This is an existing protocol path; receiver must accept both. A598-byte science frame stays enveloped.
buffer_and_wire.cancel: Existing connection-generation guards/CCCD checks and owner slot lifetime remain unchanged. Higher MTU does not make SDK waits cancellable or give a new strict total SDK deadline.
buffer_and_wire.schema: No new firmware protocol version/capability is required solely for requesting517; actual capability/result is observed through existing BLELINK mtu.

receiver_review.local_software_repo: ../SensorArray_Software and /home/csc/esp/workspace/SensorArray_Software absent; no claim about uninspected desktop UI compatibility, no software repo modified.

receiver_review.live_receiver: tools/receive_ble_text.py:callback copies every delivered bytearray and passes full bytes to reassembler; no247 cap.
receiver_review.evidence_collector: tools/capture_benchmark_ble.py:callback copies/base64-preserves entire notification and exact length; no247 cap. Existing buffered journal cap/flush interval unchanged.
receiver_review.bluez_metadata: Installed Bleak BlueZ mtu_size can return default23 absent private _acquire_mtu; collector already marks negotiated_mtu_verified=false. Do not replace actual firmware callback evidence with backend metadata or introduce AcquireWrite/AcquireNotify for this candidate.

geometry_example.kind: Arithmetic replay of current header/planner shape, not new C execution, radio trace, or throughput prediction.
geometry_example.interpretation: SDK calls per complete D message fall3 to2, but balanced~332-byte values need2 LL fragments each under251 bytes; ideal LL PDU minimum rises3 to4. ATT3+L2CAP4 overhead included. Retransmissions, encryption, controller scheduling, credit/quota and peer behavior can change actual cost. No claim that host notification callbacks equal air packet timing.

existing_regression_evidence.scope: Actual old/new planner and real wire formatter C/D/L atMTU23/247/517, maximum512, exact golden bytes; native ASan/UBSan. Not SDK negotiation/HIL.
Independent actual SDK Linux ROM and planner/header/fragment differential; target negotiation not covered.
Actual SendPayload scheduling, invalid23,247, smaller64, slot retention, cancellation/error/CRC/tick-wrap; does not currently exercise whole SendPayload at517.

minimum_regressions_before_candidate: Extend existing actual SendPayload harness for negotiated517:598 bytes=>2 G notifications,511/512 bytes raw,513 bytes fragmented,2304 bounded; preserve C/D/L CRC and immutable source bytes, no relaxed assertions.
Exercise actual connection callback MTU lifecycle: CONNECT23, MTU_EVT517, DISCONNECT23, next CONNECT23 then peer247; queued old-generation record must not send under new peer.
Use actual emitted packets for repository receiver roundtrip at247/517, raw and G transitions including CONTROL/LOG; compare final scientific frame CRC/session/identity and complete bytes.
Run existing BLE ownership/priority/error and WorkBudget tests unchanged; retain failed send, CCCD-disable/disconnect, corrupt-slot and bounded-fragment checks.

Optional actual SDK min/local/request unit fixture using gatts_process_mtu_req or direct extracted selection to show local517+peer247 remains247; source semantics already read but not newly executed in this proposal.

HIL_plan_for_root_if_authorized.comparison: Closed screen11 same CPU/CRC/planner/ADS lowhold image is baseline. Build otherwise-identical candidate with onlypreferredMtu517; label and ELF/hash separately. No FPS/PHY/connection interval/queue/priority changes.
HIL_plan_for_root_if_authorized.startup_gate: Subscribe existing C/D/L, query BLELINK before/after exact120s. Require connected1/same gen, actual mtu517. If actual remains247 or23, classify517 condition NOT_RUN, retain all evidence; do not call configuration request a successful negotiation.
HIL_plan_for_root_if_authorized.controlled_links: Record actual2M PHY, interval6*1.25ms, latency and DLE observed251; peerKnown0 staysunknown. If these change, mark them confounders rather than attributing result to MTU.
HIL_plan_for_root_if_authorized.window: Same5s warmup + measured120s capture; all query time excluded and exact monotonic capture bounds retained. Existing fail-fast WDT/MFAULT/reset and safe cleanup remain.
HIL_plan_for_root_if_authorized.data: Count complete BLE scientific frames/seq gaps/CRC/identity, verify actual received D envelope count2 for representative598B, and unchanged USB bytes/identity; retain all raw notifications and raw USB.
HIL_plan_for_root_if_authorized.service: Use before/after query-time windows for BLESVC calls/completed/wall/confError, BLETX queue ages and local accept errors, PERF/BL50 drops, CPUOWNER ownrun, SCHEDWHY and heap. SDKwall not CPUtime, CONF not PC ACK.
HIL_plan_for_root_if_authorized.acceptance: Compare complete received BLE/capture ratio and counted losses, not lower notification count alone. No new faults, starvation, control failures or unbounded waits. A result below capture is still a throughput shortfall, even if improved.
HIL_plan_for_root_if_authorized.safety: No changes to rail/calibration, no NVS save, no watchdog disable, no SDK cancellation claim. Root remains sole hardware owner.
